title: Support Neon High as a native read-only reviewer alternative
outcome: Neon High can participate in the native review workflow with an authenticated, retained structured result and an enforced read-only boundary, rather than only providing explorer prose.
acceptance: A supported native Neon High review path records the actual provider/model, candidate/base and original result identity, and returns a validated structured reviewer result to its parent through the normal retained-result and completion flow.

The reviewer submission is bound to the authenticated child/delegation context and the read-only policy remains enforced; presentation text, arbitrary tool names, another child's identity or explorer prose cannot supply reviewer authority.

Behavior tests cover a completed Neon review, missing or invalid submission, wrong-child submission and safe identical retry/recovery; existing Codex, Claude and Kimi review behavior stays valid, and unsupported runtime capability is reported explicitly.
